desc: The hero: a brave curious kid explorer about 9 years old, warm brown skin, fluffy dark curly hair poking out under a bright green leaf-shaped cap with a curled stem on top, sunflower-yellow short-sleeve explorer tunic with a coral neckerchief, sky-blue shorts, chunky orange hiking boots with green laces, a brown leather satchel across the body with a magnifying glass and a rolled map peeking out, small brass compass on the strap.

ONLY ONE creature, no humans, no other characters: Sprout: a tiny glowing seedling spirit companion, a round jelly-like lime-green body with a soft inner glow, two bright leaf sprouts on top of its head like a cowlick, huge sparkling eyes, tiny stubby arms, floating slightly with little golden pollen sparkles around it, very cute.

Exa: a cute curious young library goat standing on two legs, fluffy cream-white wool with soft caramel patches, small curled golden horns, big round tortoiseshell glasses, a tiny teal satchel overflowing with colourful little books, a red bookmark ribbon tucked behind one ear, a tiny brass bell collar, holding an open book.

Sunny the Sunflower: a cheerful sunflower person, a round face in the centre of a big ring of glossy golden-yellow petals like a lion mane, warm orange-brown seed-pattern freckles, a sturdy bright green stem body with two leaf arms waving, a tiny terracotta flower-pot skirt with a green ribbon, small brown root feet, beaming sunny smile.

Professor Chloro: a small scholarly leaf scientist, the body is a plump glossy green leaf with visible light-green veins, a white lab coat with rolled sleeves and a pocket full of coloured pencils, round brass goggles pushed up on the head, a tiny curled stem antenna on top, holding a glowing green test tube with tiny golden sparkles, kind wise eyebrows.

Rootie the Mole Explorer: a chubby velvety cocoa-brown mole with a pink star-shaped nose, small squinty friendly eyes behind a bright yellow mining helmet with a glowing lantern, big pink digging paws, an orange explorer vest with pockets full of seeds, a coil of golden root-rope over one shoulder.

Misty the Water Spirit: a playful translucent water-droplet spirit girl, body made of glossy turquoise and sky-blue water with tiny bubbles inside and shimmering highlights, hair shaped like a curling splash wave, small cloud-puff wisps around her feet as she hovers, cheeky grin, a necklace of dew-drop beads.

Oakley the Ancient Tree: a wise friendly old oak tree character, short and stout chibi trunk body with deeply detailed warm brown bark, a big fluffy bright green leafy crown with a few acorns and a little bird nest, a long mossy beard, kind crinkly eyes with round spectacles, thick root feet, leaning on a gnarled walking stick with tiny mushrooms.

The Cloudmother: a gentle motherly cloud giantess in chibi form, body made of fluffy glossy white and soft lavender-blue cumulus puffs, rosy cheeks, a tiny rainbow tiara, holding a small watering can that drips sparkling rain drops, golden sunlight on her edges, warm caring smile.
